name: Gearbox
text: Switch EXCAVA to Anthropic’s latest Claude 3.7 Sonnet. It’s the only model that delivers a measurable jump in reasoning depth without adding latency—proven in Fable 5 benchmarks. The trade-off is cost: Sonnet 3.7 is 20% pricier than the current Haiku variant, but the 0.7% gain in task accuracy justifies it for high-stakes power runs.

name: Torque
text: The real risk isn’t just cost—it’s benchmark drift. EXCAVA’s live task accuracy already drifts 0.3% weekly; Sonnet 3.7’s 0.7% gain could vanish if its reasoning style doesn’t align with our edge-case prompts. Test it on a 48-hour live slice of our worst-performing queries—if the drift stays below 0.2%, we proceed.
